_meta.description: One document per stack, materializing a per-stack severity breakdown from unified-cve-exposure (Phase 9 follow-up, docs/threat-vuln-platform/plan.md, 2026-09-02). Exists because classic OpenSearch Dashboards visualizations cannot pivot an aggregation bucket (risk_band) into real table columns -- this precomputes the pivot server-side so the dashboard panel is a plain, aggregation-free table. Rebuilt in full on every cve_enrichment_sync run (small dataset, full recompute is cheap and avoids drift). Deliberately NOT time-based.
